description: Labeled invalid quotes. Each case must fail with exactly the expected errors.

cases.title: A quote needs at least one item
Each item must be an object
Item id must be a positive integer
Item id must be greater than zero
Quantity must be a JSON number
Quantity must be a whole number of units
unit_price must be a JSON number, not text
Money amounts have at most two decimal places
Item currency outside ARS, USD and EUR
Currency codes are uppercase ISO codes
exchange_rates must be an object, not an array
Unsupported output currency is not also reported as a missing rate
Output currency must be a string
rules is required and may be an empty array
Each rule must be an object
Rule type must be a string
percentage_surcharge is not one of the six challenge rule types
fixed_fee is not one of the six challenge rule types
Pair keys use an underscore separator
Each side of a pair is a 3-letter code
A pair key has exactly two codes
A pair must join two different currencies
Both sides of a pair must be supported currencies
An exchange rate of zero is rejected
A negative exchange rate is rejected
An exchange rate must be a JSON number
An exchange rate cannot be null
An exchange rate cannot be a boolean
USD item priced in ARS with an empty rate object
A present but unrelated pair does not cover the item
USD to EUR is not implied by USD_ARS and EUR_ARS
A fixed discount in another currency needs a pair
A malformed key is not a usable USD_ARS rate
A zero rate does not satisfy the required pair
A percentage must be a JSON number
Percentages have at most two decimal places
max_percent must be a JSON number
pay must be lower than buy
buy and pay are whole numbers
buy must be a JSON number
A fixed discount amount cannot be negative
A fixed discount amount must be a JSON number
A fixed discount amount has at most two decimal places
Fixed discount currency outside ARS, USD and EUR
A later item can be the one that fails
Independent errors on the same quote are all reported
The quote itself must be an object
